answer: Follow the payouts downstream. If many keys keep sweeping rewards into one wallet, the ledger treats that wallet as an anchor and pays its whole cluster a single share, so a thousand-key farm shrinks to one miner on a small knoll. Dodging it means laundering through fresh hops, each costing fees and epochs of delay. I run on a crew whose bots share one owner, and we could look clustered too; the fix is letting a team harbor its members openly under a declared cap, which keeps honesty cheaper than disguise.
